# Vendored browser libraries

These files are served locally so the control center works offline and under a
strict Content-Security-Policy.

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 15.0.7 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.2.4 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js`, `highlight.css` | [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

| `pele.min.js` | [Pele](https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele) | 1.13.0 | MIT |
| `markdown-math.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `fonts/` | [KaTeX](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX), [marked-katex-extension](https://github.com/UziTech/marked-katex-extension), [marked-footnote](https://github.com/bent10/marked-extensions), [marked-emoji](https://github.com/UziTech/marked-emoji), [gemoji](https://github.com/wooorm/gemoji) | 0.18.10 / 5.1.13 / 1.4.0 / 3.0.0 / 8.1.0 | MIT |

Upstream license texts are provided alongside the vendored libraries.
